content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification:** deviation (fallback target).

- **Section 8(d) (p0054)** was the material failure: we licensed TrueLink to "distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit" our Credit Data — independent exploitation of Client data, squarely in walk-away territory. Narrowed to use/upload/display/copy/store "solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services to Client", leaving the surrounding words and the Non-Competition Agreement limitation verbatim.
- **Section 4 (p0043)**: no ownership, assignment or licence of Support Services work product existed anywhere (Section 10 only treats "all results of the Support Services" as Client Proprietary Information, which is confidentiality, not IP). Added one short clause granting the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free use/modify/sublicense licence.
- **Section 2(d) (p0029)** already satisfies Vendor retention of its own tools ("TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface"), so no new ownership language was added there.
